domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
a is an integer and 0 <= a <= n - 1
the expression a divided by n is a valid input to E_n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n > 1 and all integers a with 0 <= a <= n - 1, the real (or ordered) inequality E_n(a divided by n) <= H_n minus 1 holds. Moreover, E_n(a divided by n) = H_n minus 1 holds if and only if a equals n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all integers a with 0 <= a <= n - 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: index/parameter for functions E_n and constant H_n

variables.name: a
variables.role: input selector constrained by 0 <= a <= n-1

witness_dependencies: the equality condition uses the same universally quantified a (no separate existential witness is introduced)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n-1, one has E_n(a/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if a = n-1.
